description: ⚡ ACTION: Create a new DNS record (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT) for a Cloudflare zone. Set content (IP/hostname), TTL, and CDN proxy status. Returns new record ID (Cloudflare)

content.description: Record value — IP address for A/AAAA, hostname for CNAME, text for TXT

name.description: Record name — subdomain or "@" for root (e.g. "www", "api", "@")

proxied.description: Enable Cloudflare CDN proxy (default false). True = orange cloud, hides origin IP

ttl.description: TTL in seconds (1 = automatic, 60-86400 for manual)

name: infra.cloudflare.dns_create

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Create DNS Record
